newsitem.title: USA: U S West Media not in talks with Time Warner.
newsitem.headline: U S West Media not in talks with Time Warner.

text.p: U S West Media Group Chief Executive Officer Chuck Lillis said on Monday that there have been no negotiations between U S West and Time Warner Inc over arriving at a financial restructuring of assets in an entertainment partnership.
"There are no discussions underway with Time Warner at the present," Lillis told reporters on a teleconference call. He said it would be hard to forecast if there would be any in the present.

U S West Media owns 25 percent of Time Warner Entertainment and sued Time Warner when that company announced its acquisition of Turner Broadcasting System Inc. But a Delaware judge earlier this year ruled against U S West.
But Lillis added that in other respects his company is pleased with the way the entertainment partnership is working.
